resources.string: Tap Open to choose an STL, 3MF or STEP file.\n\nDrag to rotate, pinch to zoom, drag with two fingers to pan, twist two fingers to spin, double tap to reset. Tap the cube in the corner to jump to a view.
This model is too large for the memory available on this device.
The picker shows 3D model files only. Long-press Open to see all files. Tap the file name at the top to switch between recent files.
